# How to design an AI character and lock it in a reusable character sheet

**A premise, written details and one outfit become a character card and sheet you reuse in later images and videos.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_6baed9973414.webp" alt="A grid of eight memorable AI characters, from a grandma in leopard print to a sheep accountant in glasses, then the grandma speeds toward the camera on a red scooter." width="480"></p>

How to make AI characters people remember, on varg: define the character (premise, archetype, contrast), write the details (face, body, age, flaws, one signature detail), dress them (garment by garment, materials, fit, one loud colour), pick a category recipe, then lock the look in a character sheet and reuse it in later images and videos (Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3). Use when someone asks to create, design or describe a character, an AI influencer or persona, a mascot, a character sheet or turnaround, or the same character in new scenes or videos. Category recipes: varg-character-grandma, varg-character-big-guy, varg-character-cringe, varg-character-beautiful-woman, varg-character-fitness, varg-character-absurd, varg-character-cartoon. Not for multi-scene ads from real actor photos (varg-consistent-characters), a speaker on a stage (varg-character-keynote) or two-person podcasts (varg-podcast-video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-design                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-design --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```
